cases.purpose: Exact private AF_UNIX datagrams for default formatting, three tag forms, three priority forms and both PID forms.
cases.oracle: Preserved bashlogger obligations and its documented help: user.notice/tag user, facility*8+severity, operand joining, one final LF/CRLF, 2047-byte messages and 3071-byte formatted datagrams. The established project wire contract is <PRI> TAG[optional PID]: MESSAGE. Independent numeric mappings use Python logging.handlers.SysLogHandler. Linux AF_UNIX datagram semantics and sockaddr_un path capacity govern delivery and path errors.
cases.comparison: Receiver bound before each invocation; all queued datagrams drained after the child exits. Exact packet count/bytes, actual exit status, diagnostic predicate and child identity are compared. A setup-verified seccomp observer continues all socket calls and records them relative to a captured pre-builtin stdout marker: startup calls are retained separately, and invalid/oversize inputs must make zero socket calls after the marker. A valid logger call positively controls that boundary. The untouched file and 107-byte prefix receiver prove no overwrite or truncated-path delivery. Every observation, expected packet, raw stdout/stderr and PID is retained in observations.jsonl; all vectors execute despite disagreements.

cases.purpose: Operand joining and --, stdin LF/CRLF framing, NUL and empty rejection, 2047/2048 message boundaries and 3071/3072 formatted datagram boundaries.
cases.oracle: Preserved bashlogger obligations and its documented help: user.notice/tag user, facility*8+severity, operand joining, one final LF/CRLF, 2047-byte messages and 3071-byte formatted datagrams. The established project wire contract is <PRI> TAG[optional PID]: MESSAGE. Independent numeric mappings use Python logging.handlers.SysLogHandler. Linux AF_UNIX datagram semantics and sockaddr_un path capacity govern delivery and path errors.
cases.comparison: Receiver bound before each invocation; all queued datagrams drained after the child exits. Exact packet count/bytes, actual exit status, diagnostic predicate and child identity are compared. A setup-verified seccomp observer continues all socket calls and records them relative to a captured pre-builtin stdout marker: startup calls are retained separately, and invalid/oversize inputs must make zero socket calls after the marker. A valid logger call positively controls that boundary. The untouched file and 107-byte prefix receiver prove no overwrite or truncated-path delivery. Every observation, expected packet, raw stdout/stderr and PID is retained in observations.jsonl; all vectors execute despite disagreements.
